The portal gives Northpointe employees one place to open new requests and see the requests they already have open with teams using BoldDesk.
They can see where something stands without having to send another email asking for an update.
And the portal is mobile friendly and doesn't require a VPN, which is especially useful for people who aren't sitting at a desk all day.

For example, someone in Sales could bookmark the portal on their phone, log in with the same account they already use for Outlook and Teams, and submit a request while they're between meetings or out working with customers.
That may add 30 seconds to a minute up front to give us the information we need.
But that small amount of effort can save much more time later by reducing the back-and-forth needed to get the request worked.
